title: fast-vollib instrument record
description: A single fast-vollib instrument, serialized. Records are discriminated by 'instrument_type' and versioned by 'schema_version'. Objects are closed: an unknown field is an error, not ignored input. Generated from the same field table the runtime codec uses; do not edit by hand. Experimental until explicitly declared stable.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An economic underlier: what derivatives are written on.

schema_version.description: Version of the instrument record format.

instrument_id.description: Caller-chosen identity for the record. No valuation meaning.

asset_class.description: Economic class of the asset. Descriptive; selects nothing.

european_option.title: EuropeanOption
european_option.description: Option on a single underlier, exercisable only at maturity.

schema_version.description: Version of the instrument record format.

instrument_id.description: Caller-chosen identity for the record. No valuation meaning.

underlier.description: Reference to the underlier this contract is written on.

option_type.description: Call or put. The short 'c'/'p' flags are not wire format.

maturity.description: Time to maturity as a year fraction from valuation. Never a date.

settlement.description: How the contract settles at maturity.

notional.description: Contract multiplier. Non-zero and finite; negative denotes a short position.

forward.title: Forward
forward.description: Agreement to buy the underlier at maturity for a price fixed now.

schema_version.description: Version of the instrument record format.

instrument_id.description: Caller-chosen identity for the record. No valuation meaning.

underlier.description: Reference to the underlier this contract is written on.

delivery_price.description: Price agreed at inception. Any finite value, negatives included.

maturity.description: Time to maturity as a year fraction from valuation. Never a date.

settlement.description: How the contract settles at maturity.

notional.description: Contract multiplier. Non-zero and finite; negative denotes a short position.

future.title: Future
future.description: Exchange-traded contract on the underlier, expiring at maturity.

schema_version.description: Version of the instrument record format.

instrument_id.description: Caller-chosen identity for the record. No valuation meaning.

underlier.description: Reference to the underlier this contract is written on.

contract_price.description: Traded futures price. Any finite value, negatives included.

maturity.description: Time to maturity as a year fraction from valuation. Never a date.

settlement.description: How the contract settles at maturity.

notional.description: Contract multiplier. Non-zero and finite; negative denotes a short position.

instrument_ref.title: Underlier reference
instrument_ref.description: An immutable pointer to an underlier. Carries identity and descriptive metadata only -- never market data.

identifier.description: Symbol, ticker, or other stable key for the underlier.

asset_class.description: Economic class of the underlier. Descriptive; selects nothing.
